commonConstraints: neutral diffuse illumination uniform edge to edge
mathematically seamless on all four edges
no oversized masonry, macro scale, scene, curb, markings, objects, text, frame, or watermark
no cartoon, painterly, stylized, chunky geometry, dramatic damage, or baked lighting

candidates.scale: standard 20 × 10 cm pavers densely laid across 3 × 3 meters
candidates.promptMaterial: Traditional red clay paving brick, clean but lightly weathered, dense running bond, fine clay grain, restrained brick variation, narrow aged mortar or sand joints.

candidates.scale: handmade 20 × 10 cm bricks densely laid across 3 × 3 meters
candidates.promptMaterial: Antique handmade red-brown clay paving brick from 1750–1850, slightly irregular edges, muted oxblood, russet and brown firing variation, worn lime-and-sand joints, historically plausible and not ruined.
Aged but maintained municipal blacktop, dense fine aggregate, charcoal binder, subtle rolling variation, no potholes, markings, patch rectangles, or large cracks.

candidates.scale: 8–14 cm stones, hundreds visible across 3 × 3 meters
